description: This file defines the Stats class within the Goteo\Util\Stats namespace, providing methods for retrieving and caching various statistical data related to users, projects, investments, and funding within the Goteo platform.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: A utility class for retrieving and caching statistical data related to users, projects, investments, and funding activities within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Stats object with a Cacher instance and optional TTL.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a new Stats instance with a specified cache name and TTL.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to intercept calls to methods without 'get' prefix, automatically caching results if applicable.

methods.name: getTotalMoneyFunded
methods.description: Returns total money funded through investments.

methods.name: getMatchfundingRaised
methods.description: Returns total amount raised through matchfunding (calls + matcher).

methods.name: getMatchfundingSucessfulPercentage
methods.description: Returns percentage of successful matchfunded projects.

methods.name: getMatchfundingOwnersGender
methods.description: Returns gender distribution of matchfunding owners.

methods.name: getInvestTotals
methods.description: Returns list of investment totals based on filters.

methods.name: getInvestFees
methods.description: Calculates and returns total fees and VAT for investments based on filters.

methods.name: getInvestAmounts
methods.description: Returns investment amounts grouped by ranges.

methods.name: getProjectTotals
methods.description: Returns list of project totals based on filters.
